section: Maryland corporate income and franchise taxes
label: Corporate income tax rate
note: Flat rate on Maryland taxable income (from the 2025 corporate instructions); no enacted change for 2026 was found.
source_title: Comptroller of Maryland: 2025 Maryland Corporation Income Tax Return Instructions (PDF)

label: Levied by
value: Counties and Baltimore City (plus municipalities), with a small State property tax on top
note: Each county and Baltimore City sets its own rate every year before June 20.
source_title: Maryland Code, Tax-Property § 6-302 (Maryland General Assembly)

label: State property tax
value: Yes: rate set each year by the Board of Public Works
note: Maryland levies a State property tax in addition to county and city taxes.
source_title: Maryland Code, Tax-Property § 6-301 (Maryland General Assembly)

label: State oversight
value: Maryland State Department of Assessments and Taxation (SDAT)
note: SDAT's director administers the Tax-Property Article. SDAT's own website (dat.maryland.gov) refused automated access, so the statute is cited.
source_title: Maryland Code, Tax-Property § 2-201 (Maryland General Assembly)

label: Homestead assessment-increase cap
value: 10% a year for the State tax; counties and cities set 0% to 10%
note: Homestead tax credit: taxable assessment of an owner-occupied home is limited to 110% of the prior year for State tax; local percentage 100% to 110%.
source_title: Maryland Code, Tax-Property § 9-105 (Maryland General Assembly)

label: State transfer tax rate
note: 0.5% of the consideration, including any mortgage assumed by the buyer.
source_title: Maryland Code, Tax-Property § 13-203 (Maryland General Assembly)

label: State transfer tax rate for first-time Maryland home buyers
note: 0.25% on improved residential property bought as a principal residence by first-time Maryland buyers; paid entirely by the seller.
source_title: Maryland Code, Tax-Property § 13-203 (Maryland General Assembly)

label: Local recordation and transfer taxes
value: Counties levy their own recordation taxes and property transfer taxes, collected by the Clerk of the Circuit Court
note: Rates vary by county and are added to the State transfer tax.
source_title: Comptroller of Maryland: Business and personal tax tip #30, A Brief Look at Maryland Taxes (PDF)
